primary_comparison: h=0 versus h=6, paired at identical targets; report all intermediate depths
labels: At the forecast anchor, a fine center is background if its past-three-row long window matches one coherent ether phase; departure if its short window matches no phase; otherwise ambiguous. Target region uses the full fine-scale causal footprint: any departure => departure; all background => background; otherwise ambiguous. No future target is used in a label.
interpretation: Local ether incompatibility is an operational departure detector, not a glider or collision classifier. Region labels are used for scoring only. Report signed regional contributions to total error reduction and region frequencies, including ambiguous regions. No iid-cell confidence intervals.
